messages.subject: Error message with downloadHandler
parts:
downloadHandler works OK if I use spark.
http://spark.rstudio.com/mizumot88/rel/

But if I use my own server, it produces the following message:
Error: could not open file '/tmp/....png'
http://langtest.jp:3838/rel/

Does anyone know what I should do to show the plots properly?

messages.author: fb6bc9df068d45a8
messages.subject: Re: Error message with downloadHandler
parts:
After I moved all my apps from 

/var/shiny-server/www 
to
/svr/shiny-server
the error message did not show up.

However, I have faced another problem. I still cannot download the pdf files using downloadHandler.
http://langtest.jp:3838/bs/

When I click on the download button, I get "Not Found".

With spark, I have no problem downloading the files.
http://spark.rstudio.com/mizumot88/rel/

Also, with ShinyApps.io, I have no problem either.
https://langtest.shinyapps.io/alpha/

I use exactly the same codes for all three sites.
https://github.com/mizumot/rel

I would appreciate it if anyone could give me a clue about how to solve this problem.

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Error message with downloadHandler
parts:
Atsushi,

This might be a typo in your posting, but worth checking:

You have moved your applications to this location: /svr/shiny-server

- What is your shiny-server.conf using as the path? Can you verify that the 2 match?
- And did you restart your shiny-server after you moved your applications?
- What version of Shiny Server are you using?  (shiny-server --version)
- Would be helpful to see you shiny-server.conf file (/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf).

Fereshteh

messages.subject: Re: Error message with downloadHandler
parts:
Fereshteh,

Thank you very much for your advice.

I'm using Shiny Server v1.1.0.10000 (Node.js v0.10.21).

The shiny-server.conf file is as follows:

# Instruct Shiny Server to run applications as the user "shiny"
run_as shiny;

# Define a server that listens on port 3838
server {
  listen 3838;

  # Define a location at the base URL
  location / {

    # Host the directory of Shiny Apps stored in this directory
    site_dir /srv/shiny-server;

    # Log all Shiny output to files in this directory
    log_dir /var/log/shiny-server;

    # When a user visits the base URL rather than a particular application,
    # an index of the applications available in this directory will be shown.
    directory_index on;
  }
}
